rationale: The stock has already surged ~22.7% on an acquisition announcement at a 30.1% premium, and is now trading at 95.7% of today's range near the session high with extremely elevated relative volume (18.4x) that is decelerating — the easy move is largely exhausted. Price is consolidating tightly in the last few candles with minimal momentum, making both a long (chasing near the high of a post-announcement spike) and a short (fading a hard catalyst with a defined premium floor) mechanically unattractive. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable given the compressed spread between current price and the acquisition premium anchor.
